title: First Board of Governors Meeting
summary: The Board of Governors opened the 2026–27 BFL league year, reviewed league infrastructure, approved dues and prize structure, elected a Treasurer, and adopted initial league rules and traditions.

title: Inaugural BFL Draft
summary: The founding franchises will report for the first draft in Bureaucrat Football League history.

title: BFL Super Bowl Party
summary: The league will gather for Super Bowl Sunday and the closing celebration of the inaugural BFL season.
